rationale: Empirical review of artifact commit 66be65a790cf7236c7a4123c2af9dcd7a57f71b9 found no blocking or correctness defect in the R4 lens. `make build` succeeded; the focused frozen-contract guidance test passed; and the exact `./bin/mindspec validate docs --diff ae45fd7a8697b8790894412f233c977ca5e0f11a` command exited 0 with zero ERROR legs and only the brief's pre-existing missing-source-globs WARN. The AC-12 pin genuinely consults the registered Cobra tree: it resolves the live `impl adopt` command, derives the rendered invocation from `CommandPath()`, and looks up the registered `reason` flag, so a command move/rename or flag removal/rename goes red. Direct renders of both idle and review templates contain clear frozen-contract/new-spec guidance and the complete `mindspec impl adopt <spec-id> --reason "<why ...>"` form. The temporary render overlay was removed, and the bead worktree remained byte-clean at the reviewed commit.

findings.title: Build and focused AC-12 test pass
findings.detail: `make build` exited 0 and produced the binary. Go emitted a non-fatal module stat-cache permission warning for a path outside the worktree, but compilation completed successfully. `go test ./cmd/mindspec -run '^TestFrozenContractGuidance_ImplAdoptInvocationPinnedToCobraTree$' -count=1 -v` passed.

findings.title: The Cobra derivation is rename-red
findings.detail: The test calls `findCommandByPath(t, rootCmd, "mindspec impl adopt")`, derives the template needle from the returned command's `CommandPath()`, and derives the flag needle from `adoptCmd.Flags().Lookup("reason").Name`. Renaming or moving the registered leaf makes command lookup or the canonical-path assertion fail; removing or renaming the registered flag makes flag lookup fail. The rendered-template assertions then consume those live-derived values.

findings.title: Docs validation has zero error legs
findings.detail: The exact required diff validation exited 0 and printed only `[WARN] missing-source-globs`; it printed no `[ERROR]` entries.

findings.title: Idle and review renders carry accurate guidance
findings.detail: A temporary Go test overlay rendered `instruct.Context` in idle and review modes through `instruct.Render`. Idle states that implementing a previously frozen contract still goes through a new spec; review forbids such new feature work in the current spec. Both render the named externally-merged exit as `mindspec impl adopt <spec-id> --reason "<why the content already reached main outside the lifecycle>"` and link merge-safety guidance.

findings.title: Reviewed worktree remained byte-identical
findings.detail: After all probes, HEAD remained 66be65a790cf7236c7a4123c2af9dcd7a57f71b9, `git status --short --branch` showed only the branch header, both staged and unstaged diffs were empty, and the temporary `/tmp/mindspec-r4-render` directory was removed.
